hero_subtitle: See where your products are made
mfg_description: Our main factory is located in Zhejiang Province — the heart of China's manufacturing hub. Spanning 5,000+ sqm, our facility houses dedicated production lines for each product category: nail supplies, eyelash tools, PMU equipment, beauty devices, and daily chemical products.

highlights.text: R&D Center: In-house product development team that tracks global beauty trends and creates new products monthly.
Production Lines: 6 dedicated assembly lines with modern equipment for consistent quality at scale.
QC Stations: 6-stage quality inspection integrated into every production batch.
Warehouse: 2000+ sqm storage capacity for fast order fulfillment.

photo_wall_subtitle: A transparent look at our production environment
cta_description: Contact us to schedule a live video walkthrough of our factory. We're proud to show you where your products come from.
